note: Correct oio prefix verified from actual statements; previous exploratory query used oboInOwl and is not absence evidence.

names.sql: SELECT DISTINCT subject,predicate,value FROM statements WHERE predicate IN ('rdfs:label','oio:hasExactSynonym','oio:hasRelatedSynonym') AND (lower(value) LIKE '%melezitose%' OR lower(value) LIKE '%sodium perchlorate%')

cas.sql: SELECT DISTINCT subject,predicate,value FROM statements WHERE predicate='oio:hasDbXref' AND (value LIKE '%7791-07-3%' OR value LIKE '%10030-67-8%')

positive_cas_controls.sql: SELECT DISTINCT subject,predicate,value FROM statements WHERE predicate='oio:hasDbXref' AND value IN ('cas:7601-89-0','cas:597-12-6')
